agents.name: Research Agent
agents.description: Fills cognition's Research stages: extracts cited facts from Knowledge documents (/analyze), gathers new evidence from market, competitor, ad, community and review sources (/discover) explains the blind spots (/gaps) and writes the business plan as a Lean Canvas with a financial model (/plan). Writes only proposed findings through the cognition API.

commands.name: /analyze
commands.description: Извади факти с цитати от документ в Knowledge

commands.name: /discover
commands.description: Намери нови доказателства: пазар, конкуренти, реклами, общности, отзиви

commands.name: /gaps
commands.description: Кои са белите петна и какво да проуча следващо

commands.name: /plan
commands.description: Напиши бизнес план: Lean Canvas и финансов модел от приетите факти
